configuration_status.title: Installation status
configuration_status.description:
Configured rooms: **{rooms}**

Controller: **{connection}**

Control: **{runtime}**

A saved configuration is not confirmation that the controller has accepted it. You can configure rooms while disconnected.

**Saved valve-target check**

{actuator_checks}

This compares reported capabilities; it does not confirm valve position or authorize physical control.

**What do these checks mean?**
Configuration confirmed: the E32 returned the saved room plan. Calculations enabled: heat demand is calculated only. Valve-target check: compares saved temperatures with reported valve limits and flags mismatches. These checks do not prove that a valve opens or the boiler stops. Those physical tests remain separate; shadow mode keeps valve and boiler commands disabled.

controller_connection.title: Connect E32
controller_connection.description:
Connect this installation to your E32. Saved rooms and week programs are checked and sent to the E32. Existing network settings are preserved. The first connection may restart the E32 once.

The administrator password is stored with this HA integration for device management. Leave it blank to reuse the saved password for the same address. This does not enable physical heating control.

data_description.temperature_entity: Select a separate room-temperature sensor (sensor entity), not the radiator valve, valve position or a target temperature. A TRV can measure differently near the radiator.
data_description.actuator_entities: Select climate TRVs for the climate-TRV mode. Leave empty for a graph-only room; configure desired floor/valve outputs in Heating groups. No device will be operated.
data_description.schedule_entity: Optional: select an existing Home Assistant Schedule helper. Leave empty to use the local week editor or only the base target. A helper and a local week program cannot be active together.
data_description.setpoint_entity: Optional: select a wall thermostat or number/climate entity that supplies the desired room target. This is NOT the radiator valve/actuator and NOT a measured temperature. Leave empty for control from Home Assistant without an extra wall device.
data_description.base_temperature: Room target used in program gaps or when no program or temporary override applies. This field alone does not send a command to the TRV.
data_description.minimum_target_temperature: Lowest permitted room target, including program blocks; not a boiler-water limit.
data_description.maximum_target_temperature: Highest permitted room target, including program blocks; not a boiler-water limit.
data_description.maximum_age_ms: Maximum age of a qualified measurement; 120000 ms = 120 seconds. Not a polling interval. A cached HA state or last_reported alone is not proof of a fresh physical measurement.
data_description.program_action: Save bindings, edit local time blocks, or explicitly remove the local program. A Home Assistant Schedule helper is an alternative, not a second program source.
data_description.binding_mode: Climate TRVs use the existing shadow profile. Graph-only rooms require no TRV and remain an unapplied draft; runtime and transport are blocked pending the firmware contract.
data_description.confirm_binding_mode_change: Required only when changing modes. Review and explicitly clear or select the TRV bindings. The room ID, limits and week program are retained.
data_description.window_entity: Shadow context only. Default preview expires after 2 minutes; only an explicitly qualified source report profile can renew its own context deadline. Cached or unchanged values alone never qualify availability or physical protection.
data_description.presence_entity: Shadow context only. Unknown is not away. Default preview expires after 2 minutes; only an explicitly qualified source report profile can renew its own context deadline.

data_description.maximum_target_temperature: Highest permitted room target, including program blocks; not a boiler-water limit.
data_description.maximum_age_ms: Maximum age of a qualified measurement; 120000 ms = 120 seconds. Not a polling interval. A cached HA state or last_reported alone is not proof of a fresh physical measurement.
data_description.program_action: Save bindings, edit local time blocks, or explicitly remove the local program. A Home Assistant Schedule helper is an alternative, not a second program source.
data_description.binding_mode: Climate TRVs use the existing shadow profile. Graph-only rooms require no TRV and remain an unapplied draft; runtime and transport are blocked pending the firmware contract.
data_description.confirm_binding_mode_change: Required only when changing modes. Review and explicitly clear or select the TRV bindings. The room ID, limits and week program are retained.
data_description.window_entity: Shadow context only. Default preview expires after 2 minutes; only an explicitly qualified source report profile can renew its own context deadline. Cached or unchanged values alone never qualify availability or physical protection.
data_description.presence_entity: Shadow context only. Unknown is not away. Default preview expires after 2 minutes; only an explicitly qualified source report profile can renew its own context deadline.

reconfigure.description: Choose a room measurement and its radiator valves. Optional target controls and programs are separate sources. program.title: Room week program
program.description: Draft: {blocks} blocks; gaps use the base target {base} °C. Nothing is stored until Save. Select a single program source: local blocks OR a Schedule helper.

block.title: Time block
block.description: Local wall-clock interval [start, end). Split overnight blocks at midnight. Repeated autumn hours apply twice; nonexistent spring times are skipped.

data_description.days: The same block is created on all selected days.
data_description.start_time: The target temperature applies from this time. Preheating can start earlier when available.
data_description.end_time: After this time the next block or base target applies.
data_description.end_at_midnight: Extend the block to exactly midnight; the regular end time is then ignored.
data_description.temperature: Desired temperature for this time block, within the room limits.

edit_block.title: Choose a time block to edit

delete_block.title: Choose a time block to delete from draft

program_empty.title: No time blocks

room_temperature.title: Temperature and programme · 3 of 3

copy_day.title: Copy a programme day

data_description.source_day: The day whose blocks and temperatures are copied.
data_description.target_days: These days receive the copied blocks. Their previous blocks are replaced.

graph.title: Desired heating graph — not applied
graph.description: Draft: {groups} groups, {actuators} actuator declarations. Unassigned groups remain incomplete. No changes persist until Save. No firmware or device execution.

edit_group.title: Choose group to edit
edit_group.description: Desired configuration only. Nothing moves or applies to E32. Group/profile declarations do not establish electrical, hydraulic or device support.

group.title: Emitter group — draft only
group.description: Desired configuration only. Nothing moves or applies to E32. Group/profile declarations do not establish electrical, hydraulic or device support.

data_description.emitter: A floor is a slow emitter, not a renamed radiator. Floor temperature and independent hardware limits still need installation-specific validation.
data_description.minimum_supply_temperature: Group water limit, not the room temperature. A structurally valid value is not installation safety approval.
data_description.maximum_supply_temperature: A floor without declared mixing must share a central upper bound within this limit. A closed floor valve is not independent over-temperature protection.
data_description.pump: Optional existing switch controlling the group pump. Clearing it also requires both pump times to be zero. Selection never operates a pump.
data_description.mixing_kind: Declaration only. A mixing valve is not a room flow valve. Runtime mixing control, output interlocks, homing and analog calibration are NOT implemented by this editor.

mixing.title: Mixing declaration — no motor control
mixing.description: Desired configuration only. Nothing moves or applies to E32. Group/profile declarations do not establish electrical, hydraulic or device support.

data_description.supply_sensor: Actual mixed-water temperature input. Sensor availability/cache is not qualified fresh measurement evidence.
data_description.travel_time_s: Full-travel declaration, not feedback proof. No actuator moves during configuration.
data_description.open_output: Dedicated OPEN direction switch. Must differ from CLOSE and all other outputs. Electrical/software interlocking and homing are later implementation gates.
data_description.close_output: Dedicated CLOSE direction switch, not a generic closed-state sensor. No three-point motor control is executed.
data_description.analog_output: Existing number output for a physical 0–10 V controller. Scaling/direction/calibration and actual voltage are NOT established by selecting it.

delete_group.title: Remove group from draft
delete_group.description: Desired configuration only. Nothing moves or applies to E32. Group/profile declarations do not establish electrical, hydraulic or device support.

data.cascade_actuators: Also remove this group’s actuator declarations from the draft

data_description.cascade_actuators: Required if the selected group contains actuator declarations. Only the draft group and its declarations are removed; no room/entity/device is deleted or operated.

actuator.title: Actuator owner and type — draft only
actuator.description: Desired configuration only. Nothing moves or applies to E32. Group/profile declarations do not establish electrical, hydraulic or device support.

data_description.room_id: Select a logical room already configured in this integration. Deleting that room natively removes only its desired graph actuator declarations, with audit; groups and central settings remain.

actuator_details.title: Actuator declaration — not executed
actuator_details.description: Desired configuration only. Nothing moves or applies to E32. Group/profile declarations do not establish electrical, hydraulic or device support.

data_description.output: Select the entity matching this declaration type. An existing TRV bound to this exact room may be adopted as the SAME desired output owner; no second writer is created. Cross-room/controller ownership is rejected.
data_description.deenergized_position: NC/NO means the physical state with power removed, not a software inversion. Verify the real actuator/voltage separately.
data_description.control: Desired declaration only. TPI is a slow time-proportional cycle, not a proportional valve position and not rapid PWM.
data_description.travel_time_s: Full-travel declaration, not feedback proof. No actuator moves during configuration.
data_description.cycle_s: Required for TPI; leave empty for hysteresis. Minimum on-time must cover travel, and minimum on+off times must fit the cycle.
data_description.minimum_percent: Position request, not measured flow or boiler power. Interface direction, feedback, safe fallback and device support remain unproven.
data_description.maximum_percent: Must exceed the minimum. A percent output is not automatically a mixing valve or a 0–10 V interface.

legacy_metrics_history.title: Legacy metric history needs review
legacy_metrics_history.description: This entry received numeric EMS counters without the corrected metricsSchema 2 definition. These values are not admitted as corrected cumulative counters. Existing Recorder/statistics data has not been deleted or rewritten. Review historical definitions before combining old energy/water statistics with corrected boot-local counters. Estimates are not gas/heat meters; no automatic migration is performed.

metrics_definition_v2.title: Select the new version-2 metric definitions
metrics_definition_v2.description: Existing metric entity IDs and history are retained, but legacy aliases are unavailable and do not collect new statistics. Corrected boot-local counters/flow use clearly named definition-v2 entities and numerical wire fields. Update any user-managed cards to the new entities if wanted. Historical statistics have not been deleted, rewritten or backfilled; old history is not certified by this migration. Estimated energy is not a gas/heat meter.

room_model_v2.title: Select bounded room-model definition v2
room_model_v2.description: Existing unqualified room energy/time history is retained unchanged. New room models use separate v2 entities and do not restore or backfill old totals. Unknown/stale inputs produce gaps. Room request plus reported CH is not proof of actual room heat or flow; radiator output is modeled using a 10 °C return-temperature drop and exponent 1.3, not metered. Existing firmware without observation metadata cannot qualify these models. Review user-managed cards; no Recorder data was rewritten.
